blocks.compare_with: rc01_hw_c72_sc20_20261030_01 (c72 strict baseline, combined arm, D = 20 ms)

each request has exactly one bound, complete and successful response of the arm image size (READ 141/158 octets, SELECT/OPERATE 60, CROB SUCCESS from the captured bytes)
losses, retransmissions and application failures counted separately; CLRT by class against the response-ready-ACK-then-D contract (no precision criterion)
falsifier: any trial whose captured request transactions are not the strict order, or whose master records differ
any request without exactly one bound, complete and successful response
any master request received on dev9 and not forwarded (busy drop) or any unexpected drop or capture drop
stale T/N state reported by the existing switch checks
failed restoration

a relay reply to a forwarded late ACK that changes what the master receives is a c74 defect of the H2 rows and is reported as such: (b) > 1, a first-exchange CLRT outside the arm's c72 spread, or a trial failure
blocks.mechanism: c74 = c72 + const-entry rows (results/builds/c74/README.md): a READ/SELECT/OPERATE that finds N's single work cell held retries through n_RETRY_BUDGET (busy_retry_ack, busy_retry_rst_next, busy_exhausted) instead of busy_drop; a pure master ACK at owner 0xd/0xe with client_diff exactly -25/-27 and server_diff 0 (the late handshake ACK) is forwarded unchanged (forward_original) instead of aborted. Residuals: R1 (an old ACK delayed behind the next 25/27-octet READ) and R2 (a pure ACK at ISN-1/ISN+3) are also forwarded. The block tests the H1 request retry and the H2 late-ACK forward under the workload of the c72 block it repeats.

late_ack_reply_observable.purpose: review H-1: c74 forwards the late handshake ACK (sequence = master ISN+1) after the first request; the relay may answer that out-of-window segment with an ACK (RFC 9293), which N admits as first_read_ack and T receives as an extra response-ready ACK (untested in the model)
per_fresh_connection: (b) pure ACKs delivered to the master before the first response, from in.pcap
(a) and (d) need the relay-leg mirror and are not observable on this non-diagnostic block
late_ack_reply_observable.c72_baseline: (a) = 1 and (b) = 1 in 64 of 64 connection starts (rc01_hw_c72diag_e2c_20261030_01 and rc01_hw_c72diag_e2_20261028_01)
late_ack_reply_observable.falsifier: a relay reply to a forwarded late ACK that changes what the master receives is a c74 defect of the H2 rows and is reported as such: (b) > 1, a first-exchange CLRT outside the arm's c72 spread, or a trial failure
late_ack_reply_observable.not_usable_on_hardware: T outcome counters read null on hardware (snapshots: layout no_switch_telemetry), so ACK_COMMIT / RESP_FALLBACK cannot be used there

fixed_denominators.note: planned denominators; each campaign stops at its first failed trial, so the reported denominator is the trials actually run, with the failure reported as found

observable_summary: per definition below; every block inherits the observable and checks of the c72 design it repeats
stop_rules: unsafe ownership or unverified restoration stops all writes
no rerun-until-pass, no extra trials or blocks
a failed trial stays FAIL and is reported as found
stop at the first failure: a failed trial ends its campaign (campaign_base StepFailed); the trials not run are reported as not run, not as passed, against the planned denominator
guarded points stay {1,3}; one block per campaign; registration, freeze, exact-argv dry run and restoration for every block
reporting: every loss, retransmission and application failure separately, with denominators, beside the c72 result named in compare_with
zero losses observed in N trials, or the count; never an unconditional loss-free claim
mirror evidence for packet presence and content only
interpretation_limits: bounded confirmation trials, not rate estimates
master-NIC captures do not observe the relay-facing link or switch departure timing
the model qualification of c74 is SDK tofino-model functional output only
the relay select timeout stays unverified
